description: He spends $500K a day on Meta ads — and his advice is shockingly simple 👀 I asked this guy how much he spends on Meta ads. He said: “About 500 grand a day.” 😳 Then he dropped a tip every advertiser needs to tattoo on their forehead: “Keep Meta simple. Don’t overcomplicate it.” You don’t have to be the smartest person in the room. You just have to stop breaking what already works. Simple scales. Complex fails. And sometimes… stupid people make a ton of money. 😂 Would your ads perform better if you just stopped overthinking them? 👇 Comment “SCALE” if you want to apply to work with me 1:1 and learn how to build ad systems that actually scale. 🚀
